sources.entry: Bzz - Automatic keyboard layout switcher (RU↔EN). Detects mistyped words like "ghbdtn" and replaces with "привет" on the fly. Open-source replacement for the abandoned Punto Switcher.

summary.one_liner: Bzz is a macOS menu-bar tool that automatically converts words typed on the wrong keyboard layout (e.g. "ghbdtn" to "привет") between Russian and English.
summary.what_it_does: Bzz runs in the macOS menu bar and uses a CGEventTap to watch keystrokes in real time. When you press Space, Enter, or punctuation, it checks whether the typed word is a Russian word once converted from the QWERTY keymap, using an embedded 98K-word frequency dictionary with Snowball stemming. For words of 6+ characters it also tries fuzzy matches within one Levenshtein edit. Matching words are replaced by sending backspace and character events. Cmd+Z reverts a correction within 5 seconds, and a tray icon toggles pause/resume. Settings such as excluded apps, primary language, and minimum word length live in a YAML config file, and the app can launch at login via a LaunchAgent. According to the README, the core is MIT-licensed and processes keystrokes locally with no HTTP client in the binary.
use_cases: fix Russian text typed on English layout automatically
stop retyping words after wrong keyboard layout
switch Cyrillic and Latin layouts on macOS
replace Punto Switcher on a Mac
notable: Embedded 98K-word Russian frequency dictionary with Snowball stemming, no network calls
Cmd+Z undo window of 5 seconds after an auto-correction
Per-app exclusions via config.yaml, changes apply without restart
Tray icon shows active (⚡) or paused (💤) state
Ships an optional Pro tier planned for Q3 2026 (one-time purchase) while the core stays MIT
caveats: Requires macOS 10.15+ and Accessibility permission to intercept keystrokes
Release binary is not signed; Gatekeeper workaround needed (xattr or Open Anyway)
Windows support is only mentioned as planned in the features list, though the README also describes a cross-compile target
Planned Pro features (custom dictionary, extra layouts, per-app UI) are not yet released
